```{r setup}
# Run code from the project root so targets can find its data store
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "..")
```

```{r load}
library(targets)
config     <- tar_read(config)
ws         <- sf::st_read(tar_read(watershed_final), quiet = TRUE)
streams    <- sf::st_read(tar_read(streams_final), quiet = TRUE)
dem        <- terra::rast(tar_read(dem_harmonized))
catalog    <- read.csv(tar_read(layer_catalog))
dictionary <- read.csv(tar_read(data_dictionary))
```

## Study area

```{r study-area, results = "asis"}
cat(paste0(
  "**Watershed:** ", ws$watershed_name, " (HUC12 ", ws$huc12, ")  \n",
  "**Area:** ", round(ws$area_km2, 1), " km²  \n",
  "**Output CRS:** EPSG:", config$crs, "  \n",
  "**Grid resolution:** ", config$resolution_m, " m"
))
```

## Maps

```{r map-dem, fig.cap = "Harmonized DEM with stream network (blue) and watershed boundary (red)."}
terra::plot(dem, main = "Elevation (m)")
terra::lines(terra::vect(streams), col = "blue")
terra::lines(terra::vect(ws), col = "red", lwd = 2)
```

```{r map-order, fig.cap = "Stream network by Strahler stream order."}
plot(sf::st_geometry(ws), border = "grey40", main = "Stream order")
plot(streams["stream_order"], add = TRUE, lwd = streams$stream_order)
```

## Quality checks

```{r qa}
res <- config$resolution_m

# Share of DEM cells inside the watershed that are missing
inside  <- terra::rasterize(terra::vect(ws), dem)
dem_in  <- terra::mask(dem, inside)
n_in    <- terra::global(inside, "notNA")[[1]]
n_na_in <- n_in - terra::global(dem_in, "notNA")[[1]]

dem_rng <- as.numeric(terra::global(dem, c("min", "max"), na.rm = TRUE))
str_rng <- range(c(streams$elev_min_m, streams$elev_max_m), na.rm = TRUE)

checks <- data.frame(
  check = c(
    "All layers use the output CRS",
    "DEM cell size matches config",
    "DEM grid snapped to cell size",
    "No missing DEM cells inside watershed",
    "DEM elevations in plausible range (500 to 4500 m)",
    "All streams fall within the watershed",
    "Stream elevations within 50 m of DEM range"
  ),
  result = c(
    paste(unique(c(sf::st_crs(ws)$epsg, sf::st_crs(streams)$epsg,
                   terra::crs(dem, describe = TRUE)$code)), collapse = ", "),
    paste(terra::res(dem), collapse = " x "),
    paste("xmin", terra::xmin(dem), "/ ymin", terra::ymin(dem)),
    paste0(n_na_in, " of ", n_in, " cells"),
    paste(round(dem_rng, 1), collapse = " to "),
    paste(sum(lengths(sf::st_within(streams, sf::st_buffer(ws, 1)))), "of", nrow(streams)),
    paste0("streams ", paste(round(str_rng, 1), collapse = " to "),
           "; DEM ", paste(round(dem_rng, 1), collapse = " to "))
  ),
  pass = c(
    all(c(sf::st_crs(ws)$epsg, sf::st_crs(streams)$epsg,
          as.numeric(terra::crs(dem, describe = TRUE)$code)) == config$crs),
    all(terra::res(dem) == res),
    terra::xmin(dem) %% res == 0 && terra::ymin(dem) %% res == 0,
    n_na_in == 0,
    dem_rng[1] > 500 && dem_rng[2] < 4500,
    all(lengths(sf::st_within(streams, sf::st_buffer(ws, 1))) > 0),
    str_rng[1] > dem_rng[1] - 50 && str_rng[2] < dem_rng[2] + 50
  )
)
checks$pass <- ifelse(checks$pass, "PASS", "CHECK")
knitr::kable(checks, col.names = c("Check", "Result", "Status"))
```

Checks marked CHECK are not necessarily errors; see the decision log for known differences (for example, stream attributes describe whole flowlines, not the clipped segments).

## Layer catalog

```{r catalog}
knitr::kable(catalog[, c("layer", "source", "version", "retrieved",

```
